description: This file defines the HttpExceptionNormalizer class in the Drupal JSON:API module, responsible for normalizing HttpException objects into JSON:API error objects, including handling cacheability, user permissions, and error details.

classes.name: HttpExceptionNormalizer
classes.description: A class that normalizes HttpException objects into JSON:API error format, considering cacheability, user permissions, and error details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the current user object.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes an HttpException object into a JSON:API error response, with cacheability and context handling.

methods.name: buildErrorObjects
methods.description: Builds error objects for the JSON:API response based on the HttpException details.

methods.name: getInfoUrl
methods.description: Provides a URL to the RFC-2616 section corresponding to the HTTP status code.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns the supported exception types for normalization.
